answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The quill lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the terrace is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
